# Kinetype

Kinetype is a free typing speed test with WPM and accuracy scores, plus practical guides to work-from-home transcription, captioning, subtitling, data entry and virtual assistant jobs.

## Tools
- [Free typing test](https://kinetype.app/) - WPM, accuracy and error tracking in 15/30/60/120 second or word-count modes
- [All articles](https://kinetype.app/articles) - searchable directory of every WFH job guide and pay research piece
- [Rev typing test guide](https://kinetype.app/rev-typing-test) - what the Rev application tests and how to pass it
- [TranscribeMe typing test guide](https://kinetype.app/transcribeme-typing-test) - TranscribeMe application requirements and practice

## Transcription jobs
- [Transcription jobs](https://kinetype.app/transcription-jobs) - overview of transcription work, platforms and pay
- [How to become a transcriptionist from home](https://kinetype.app/how-to-become-a-transcriptionist) - the step by step path from typing test to first job
- [Transcription jobs in the Philippines](https://kinetype.app/transcription-jobs-philippines) - Philippine market guide with real pay figures
- [Tagalog transcription jobs](https://kinetype.app/tagalog-transcription-jobs) - bilingual Tagalog transcription work
- [How to get transcription jobs online](https://kinetype.app/how-to-get-transcription-jobs) - the realistic path to your first transcription job
- [Transcription jobs in South Africa](https://kinetype.app/transcription-jobs-south-africa) - platforms that accept SA transcribers and pay in rands
- [Transcription jobs for students in the Philippines](https://kinetype.app/transcription-jobs-for-students-philippines) - part-time transcription that fits around class
- [Transcriptionist salary](https://kinetype.app/transcriptionist-salary) - honest pay math: per audio minute rates vs real hourly earnings

## Typing jobs and data entry
- [Typing test for WFH jobs](https://kinetype.app/typing-test-wfh-jobs) - which WFH roles need typing tests and what speeds they require
- [How to pass a typing test for a job](https://kinetype.app/how-to-pass-a-typing-test-for-a-job) - what employers test and a two week practice plan
- [Encoding jobs in the Philippines](https://kinetype.app/encoding-jobs-philippines) - data encoder work, pay and where to apply
- [Data entry jobs in the Philippines](https://kinetype.app/data-entry-jobs-philippines) - entry-level data entry without experience

## Virtual assistant and captioning
- [How to become a virtual assistant in the Philippines](https://kinetype.app/how-to-become-a-virtual-assistant-philippines) - VA roles, requirements and pay
- [Captioning jobs for beginners](https://kinetype.app/captioning-jobs-for-beginners) - closed captioning from home
- [Subtitle jobs from home](https://kinetype.app/subtitle-jobs-from-home) - subtitling work, pay and how to apply
